people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: His mother’s brothers spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words. Their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, “He is our brother.”
translations.bsb: And when his mother’s brothers spoke all these words about him in the presence of all the leaders of Shechem, their hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, “He is our brother.”
translations.kjv: And his mother's brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.
